verdict.rationale: Relay's own docs claim that captured receipts and categorized expenses sync to your accounting software automatically, and that detailed transaction data syncs directly into QuickBooks Online and Xero. This is a direct first-party capability for this story. missing for 10: in-depth setup or sync-behavior documentation (frequency, field mapping, two-way sync), independent or hands-on corroboration of the accounting sync, and coverage of accounting platforms beyond QBO and Xero.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can sync transactions and expenses automatically with my accounting software

citations.quote: Capture receipts, categorize expenses in real time, and sync everything to your accounting software automatically.
Relay syncs ultra-detailed, easy-to-understand transaction data directly into QuickBooks Online and Xero.
